<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_Dismissal"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/dismissal">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Dismissal" name="Dismissal"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Dismissal">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MSPN" name="MSPN" processRef="Process_MSPN"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MSPO" name="MSPO" processRef="Process_MSPO"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Dismissal"
                      name="Dismissal"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendDismissal"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_DismissalReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MSPN" name="MSPN sends dismissal" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MSPN"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDismissal" name="Send dismissal" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DismissalSent" name="Dismissal sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPN_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MSPN" targetRef="Task_SendDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPN_2" sourceRef="Task_SendDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_DismissalSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MSPO" name="MSPO handles dismissal" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DismissalReceived" name="Dismissal received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DismissalReceived" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDismissal" name="Review dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DismissalDecision" name="Dismissal decision"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DismissalRejected" name="Dismissal rejected"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DismissalConfirmed" name="Dismissal confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_DismissalReceived" targetRef="Task_ReviewDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_2" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDismissal" targetRef="Gateway_DismissalDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_Reject" name="Reject" sourceRef="Gateway_DismissalDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_DismissalRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO_Confirm" name="Confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_DismissalDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_DismissalConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
